name: Beasts of the Apocalypse: Story for Two
source:
The two of you were enjoying a peaceful life. But suddenly, the world is overrun by man-eating “beasts” from beyond! Will you be able to survive this new world where one wrong choice will be the end of you? The outcome is up to you in this cooperative multi-ending story!

[From Google Play]
translation:
你们两人原本过着平静的生活，世界却突然被来自异界、以人为食的“兽”占领！在这个选错一步就会丧命的新世界里，你们能活下去吗？在这段拥有多个结局的双人合作故事中，结局将由你们决定！

[译自Google Play]
